main.description: P10.2 validator between cinematography (LLM, kind='llm') and simulate_one fan-out. Clamps + validates the raw LLM camera output (`shot` enum, `fov_deg` ∈ [15,85], `roll_deg` ∈ [-25,25], 3-float vectors, light role/colour/direction shape) and replaces malformed light arrays with the 3-point default. Output is the runtime `camera_plan` channel consumed by simulate_one + render_keyframes. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_validate_camera_plan.

cameraPlanRaw.description: Raw JSON object emitted by the cinematography LLM node — pre-clamp, may carry malformed fields.

fallbackShot.description: Manga-grammar enum to fall back to when the LLM's `shot` field is unknown or missing. Default MediumShot.

camera.description: {shot, eye, target, up, fov_deg, roll_deg, dof}. dof is null unless DoF is engaged.

lights.description: 3-point lighting set; each entry carries role∈{Key,Fill,Rim,Ambient} + direction[3] + colour[3] + intensity.

llm.description: True when the LLM produced a non-empty cameraPlanRaw; false when the validator fell back to pure presets.
